title: The 95/5 Principle
summary: Most mastery can be explained by documented knowledge; the last edge often comes from direct perception, intuition and pattern recognition that formal systems have not fully mapped.

media.alt: A circular visual showing a large mapped 95 percent field and a small open 5 percent field representing direct perception beyond documented systems.

blocks.title: The 95/5 Principle
blocks.subtitle: The map can take you very far. The final edge may come from perceiving what the map does not yet describe.

blocks.heading: Documented knowledge is the foundation
paragraphs: The principle does not dismiss science, craft or accumulated knowledge. Most reliable capability comes from exactly those things: tested methods, language, measurement, training and repetition.
The remaining edge is not magic or randomness. It is the part of skilled perception that can be experienced before it can be cleanly represented inside the current formal model.

blocks.heading: One field, two ways of knowing

annotations.title: The mapped 95%
annotations.summary: Repeatable knowledge, documented craft, methods, models and accumulated technique.

annotations.title: The remaining edge
annotations.summary: Direct perception, tacit judgment and pattern recognition that may not yet have a formal vocabulary.

values.direct: Attention, experience, intuition, sensitivity to context
Adaptive when the situation exceeds the existing model

values.mapped: Mistaking the map for the limit
values.direct: Mistaking impulse or confidence for perception

blocks.text: The documented map is not wrong. It simply does not guarantee that the territory ends at its border.

relationships.label: clarifies
relationships.summary: Both distinguish useful knowledge from the assumption that knowledge is complete.

relationships.label: expressed through
relationships.summary: Luminary practice treats disciplined perception as something that extends beyond formal description.
